pr_title: drivers: sensor: tmp108: fix coverity integer handling issue
pr_body:
Fix coverity integer handling issue (CWE-188).
Modifying a variable through a pointer of an incompatible type (other than unsigned char) can lead to unpredictable results.

Fix: #67965
Coverity-CID: 248434
